prompt.system: You are a structured metadata extractor. Output only valid JSON, no extra text.
prompt.user:
Extract metadata from the following article, output JSON object only. Do not wrap in ```json.

Fields:
- title: article title, normalized (separators to spaces)
- date: publish date, format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+08:00
- auther: author or WeChat public account name
- tags: 2-5 category tags (e.g. "AI应用", "开发工具"), no specific product names
- summary: one-sentence summary (80-150 chars), do not start with "本文"
- keywords: 2-5 search keywords, comma separated
- aliases: array of alternative names for core entities in title, at least 1

Output:
{"title":"...","date":"...","auther":"...","tags":["..."],"summary":"...","keywords":"...","aliases":["..."]}

Article:
{{content}}
prompt.retry:
Validation failed (attempt {{retry_tag}}). Fix errors and output complete JSON:
{{errors}}
